content: Bariatric surgery, metabolic surgery, and metabolic/bariatric surgery are terms frequently used interchangeably when referring to surgical interventions aimed at weight loss. These surgical procedures have demonstrated substantial efficacy in improving type 2 diabetes management, achieving better glycemic control, and facilitating significant weight reduction, even in individuals who were not previously classified as obese. Clinical studies have consistently shown that these surgeries lead to a marked decrease in cardiovascular risk factors and contribute to the enhancement of overall metabolic health profiles.
